# `silk/text/word_dictionary_khmer`

<!-- Generated by silk doc-reference. Do not edit by hand. -->

The packed ICU Khmer word dictionary trie for `silk.text.word_dictionary`.

## When to use
Use `IcuDictionary` in `silk.text.word_dictionary`, which reads this data. Use this module
only to read the packed trie directly.

## Details
The data is `khmerdict.txt` of ICU release 78.1: 81028 words in 67897 nodes and 132542 edges. A
node is a u32: the index of its first edge (24 bits), its edge count (7 bits) and 1 when a word
ends there (low bit). Edge `i` has the label `labels()[i]` and leads to the node in the little-
endian u32 at `targets()[4 * i]`. The edges of a node are consecutive and sorted by label. A
label is a scalar minus `base()`; U+200C and U+200D are the labels 0xfe and 0xff.
`rootTargets()` holds the child of the root for each of the 256 labels, or 0.

Import as `word_dictionary_khmer` with `import silk.text.word_dictionary_khmer as word_dictionary_khmer`.
